text:
The plate is a square side plate, roughly 20-22 cm across. It holds about 35-40 almonds and a small pile of spinach leaves with a few shreds of carrot.

Almonds: each weighs about 1.2 g, so 38 almonds come to roughly 45 g. At about 5.8 kcal/g that is around 260 kcal.

Spinach: about 30 g at 0.23 kcal/g is roughly 7 kcal. The carrot adds about 2 g, or about 1 kcal.

Total: about 75-80 g of food and about 270 kcal.
